browser.scope: tests/enemy-animation-browser.cjs in final npm test, all species/directions/states, fixed pivots and mutation freeze

AI_tests.scope: includes pack separation, delayed Compy bite, harmless edge-aware flee, first-biome charge/locked aim/sideways dodge, tail warning and single strike, front vs rear armor, meat-gated difficulty and predator cap

visual_review.4x: All64frames inspected on both backgrounds; changed registrations re-inspected. Clips, lateral gapes and wrong North charge excluded.

visual_review.remaining: Generated markings and body shapes vary slightly; full temporal/user art approval pending. Compy E/W and Carnotaurus N action deliberately reuse reviewed stride poses.

opening_sample_limit: Seeded nearest-target simulation,60steps/sec, hold attack, collect nearby meat, prefer teeth upgrade. No injected meat/XP or enemy HP. Stops at boss appearance, not boss victory. This is not human playtesting or a guarantee of player completion times.
historical_context: Evidence captured before larger maps and rarity progression. Opening hunt timings apply to that earlier version; see world_runtime_report.json for current source/runtime evidence.
